homepage.whyTitle: Why patients choose N.P.N. Care Hospital.
homepage.whyText: Modern care should feel easy to understand, respectful to the family, and guided by doctors who look beyond symptoms.
homepage.philosophyText: N.P.N. Care Hospital believes recovery begins when patients understand their body, their reports, their daily habits, and the treatment path ahead. We combine natural therapies with experienced medical guidance so care feels calm, personal, and practical.
philosophyBullets: Listen first, then design a care plan around the patient.
Use natural therapies responsibly with medical history and reports.
Support long-term wellness through follow-up, routines, and prevention.
homepage.aboutTitle: A modern destination for natural and integrative healing.
homepage.aboutLead: N.P.N. Care Hospital brings together Ayurveda, Naturopathy, Electro Homeopathy, lifestyle guidance, and compassionate clinical review so patients can understand their health and make confident care decisions.
aboutBullets: Treatment plans are personalized to medical history, reports, age, lifestyle, and family needs.
Pamphlet details are organized into simple sections for families, senior citizens, insured patients, and eligible low-income patients.
Every service is presented clearly, without poster-style clutter or confusing medical language.
homepage.missionTitle: To make natural and integrative care more accessible for everyday families.
homepage.missionText: We help patients move from symptom confusion to a clear care pathway built around consultation, therapy, documentation, and follow-up.
homepage.visionTitle: To build a trusted N.P.N. Care Hospital network across India.
homepage.visionText: The pamphlet mentions more than 18 hospitals across India; the website turns that ambition into a modern digital healthcare experience.
homepage.statsTitle: Trust signals that help patients feel confident immediately.
homepage.schemesTitle: Important schemes and notices made simple for patients.
homepage.schemesText: The original pamphlet information is converted into clear, patient-friendly cards so families can understand support schemes without reading a crowded poster.
homepage.responsibleTitle: No medical promise is shown without consultation.
homepage.responsibleText: Treatment suitability, written terms, insurance approval, refund rules, and expected outcomes must be confirmed with the hospital team during registration.
homepage.departmentsTitle: Integrated healthcare departments for whole-person care.
homepage.departmentsText: Each department is designed as a care pathway, not just a service name.
homepage.conditionTitle: A clearer directory of the health concerns patients ask about.
homepage.conditionText: Patients can start from common symptoms or disease areas, then speak with a doctor before beginning any treatment plan.
homepage.treatmentsTitle: Condition-focused treatment cards for fast understanding.
homepage.treatmentsText: Patients can browse by condition, understand the pathway, and request the right appointment quickly.
homepage.journeyTitle: A guided path from first call to long-term wellness.
homepage.storiesTitle: Real outcomes presented with dignity and clarity.
homepage.galleryTitle: Types of facilities, and community presence.
homepage.facilitiesTitle: Hospital facilities designed for calm, safe visits.
homepage.facilitiesText: From reception to therapy rooms, every patient touchpoint is presented as a clean, comfortable, and professional healthcare environment.
homepage.toolsTitle: Find the right next step in seconds.
homepage.toolsText: Search doctors, match a treatment, calculate BMI, switch language, and use accessibility controls before booking.
homepage.videoTitle: Education, patient awareness, and doctor guidance.
homepage.blogTitle: SEO-ready health education for patients and families.
homepage.faqTitle: Simple answers for patients who need confidence before visiting.
homepage.appointmentTitle: A calm, fast booking experience for every patient.
homepage.appointmentText: Share your preferred treatment, doctor, date, and time. The care desk can route your request to the right department and confirm by phone or WhatsApp.

treatments.title: Joint Pain
treatments.summary: Mobility-focused care for knee, shoulder, and chronic joint discomfort.
treatments.details: A personalized plan may include doctor consultation, posture assessment, Ayurveda therapies, naturopathy support, diet correction, and guided mobility routines.

treatments.title: Diabetes Care
treatments.summary: Integrated lifestyle, nutrition, monitoring, and metabolic support.
treatments.details: Care focuses on blood sugar awareness, weight management, food habits, stress, sleep, and doctor-led follow-up for safer long-term control.

treatments.title: Kidney Care
treatments.summary: Supportive wellness plans for kidney health, stones, and preventive monitoring.
treatments.details: Doctors guide hydration habits, diet, medical history review, lab monitoring, and safe supportive therapies based on the patient's condition.

treatments.title: Liver Care
treatments.summary: Digestive, detox, nutrition, and lifestyle support for liver wellness.
treatments.details: The care pathway emphasizes safe evaluation, dietary correction, metabolic improvement, and holistic routines that reduce avoidable strain.

treatments.title: Heart Care
treatments.summary: Lifestyle, monitoring, and supportive integrative care for heart wellness.
treatments.details: Doctors review symptoms, reports, medicines, diet, stress, and activity patterns before recommending a safe supportive care plan.

treatments.title: Lung and Breathing Care
treatments.summary: Supportive care for breathing difficulty, recurring cough, and respiratory weakness.
treatments.details: The program may include medical review, breathing practices, trigger awareness, immunity support, and follow-up guidance.

treatments.title: Spine and Cervical Care
treatments.summary: Care for cervical pain, back pain, disc-related discomfort, and posture concerns.
treatments.details: A structured pathway helps patients understand pain triggers, posture, mobility, therapies, and practical home routines.

treatments.title: Nerve and Numbness Care
treatments.summary: Support for nerve blockage concerns, numbness, tingling, and limb discomfort.
treatments.details: Doctors assess medical history and symptoms carefully, then guide therapies, diet, exercise, and referral needs where appropriate.

treatments.title: Paralysis Rehabilitation Support
treatments.summary: Long-term supportive rehabilitation planning for paralysis and weakness.
treatments.details: Care focuses on supervised support, family guidance, therapy routines, prevention of complications, and regular progress review.

treatments.title: Stone and Urinary Care
treatments.summary: Doctor-led guidance for kidney stone concerns, urinary discomfort, and hydration habits.
treatments.details: Patients are guided through report review, hydration, diet, symptom monitoring, and appropriate clinical referral when needed.

treatments.title: Thyroid
treatments.summary: Whole-person support for thyroid balance, weight, mood, and energy.
treatments.details: A doctor-led program looks at reports, symptoms, nutrition, stress, sleep, and routine habits to support more stable health.

treatments.title: Skin Disorders
treatments.summary: Natural and clinical care for recurring skin concerns and inflammation.
treatments.details: Plans may combine internal health review, diet changes, cleansing routines, Ayurveda support, and follow-up for visible progress.

treatments.title: Digestive Disorders
treatments.summary: Gut-focused care for acidity, bloating, constipation, and irregular digestion.
treatments.details: Treatment is built around food timing, trigger mapping, stress regulation, digestive therapies, and practical lifestyle changes.

treatments.title: Back Pain
treatments.summary: Posture, therapy, and recovery programs for back and spine discomfort.
treatments.details: The pathway may include pain evaluation, movement guidance, therapies, ergonomic education, and follow-up tracking.

treatments.title: Arthritis
treatments.summary: Comfort, flexibility, and inflammation support for arthritis patients.
treatments.details: Care combines physician assessment, gentle therapies, anti-inflammatory nutrition, daily movement planning, and patient education.

treatments.title: Migraine
treatments.summary: Trigger-led migraine care for stress, sleep, digestion, and lifestyle patterns.
treatments.details: Doctors help identify triggers, improve routines, and build a preventive care plan alongside appropriate medical guidance.

treatments.title: Women's Health
treatments.summary: Respectful care for hormonal, metabolic, reproductive, and wellness needs.
treatments.details: Programs support menstrual concerns, fatigue, weight, stress, family health, and preventive wellness.

treatments.title: Respiratory Care
treatments.summary: Breathing, immunity, allergy, and lifestyle support for respiratory wellness.
treatments.details: Care includes breathing practices, trigger awareness, immunity support, environment guidance, and doctor-led monitoring.

treatments.title: Cancer Supportive Care
treatments.summary: Supportive wellness guidance for strength, nutrition, comfort, and coordinated referral.
treatments.details: This is supportive care only and does not replace oncology treatment. Doctors help families with nutrition, fatigue, comfort, and safe coordination with specialist medical care.

faqs.q: Do I need previous reports for consultation?
faqs.a: Bring any recent reports, prescriptions, scans, or discharge summaries. The doctor can still guide you if you do not have them.

faqs.q: Can senior citizens book appointments easily?
faqs.a: Yes. Families can book online call the hospital, or use WhatsApp for assisted booking.

faqs.q: Are Ayurveda, Naturopathy, and Electro Homeopathy used together?
faqs.a: Doctors recommend an integrated plan only after reviewing the patient's condition, medical history, current treatment, and reports.
The pamphlet lists consultation timing as 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM, with Sunday closed.
The pamphlet mentions a free-treatment support scheme for eligible poor families. Please confirm eligibility and documents at the hospital desk.
The pamphlet says patients may receive support through private insurance policies, subject to policy terms and approval.

faqs.q: What about the assurance mentioned in the pamphlet?
faqs.a: Any assurance, refund process, or written documentation should be confirmed at registration, including eligibility, exclusions, and treatment-completion requirements.
The helpline numbers are visible throughout the website for urgent help and quick routing.
